scope: Conservative readonly aggregate extras for internal C owned/ref iteration callbacks and parallel map workers. Public size-dependent C ABI preserved. Other backend algorithms unchanged.

runtime.candidateStatus: integrated compiler58, source hashes pinned before timing
runtime.method: Integrated compiler58 readonly aggregate extras. Standard external xorshift/checksum C driver, emitted modules in separate translation unit; handwritten C inline with same driver. Three warmup groups and nine sample groups rotating subject start order, 32768 calls/sample. All accumulated checksums checked. All29 kernel emissions in O0/O1 baseline/candidate checked per-call against handC64inputs under UBSan before timing. No concurrent builds/tests.

staticEntryObservations.method: objdump of exact separately linked timed executables, restricted to the public kernel entry. Counts static memcpy call sites, not dynamic copies or all allocations.

warmCompilation.method: 29 prepared exec-bench programs, each compiled8times per sample; optimized C emission, no FunctionCache, three warmup groups then9rotating samples. Includes optimizer+emission. All byte sums checked.
warmCompilation.caveat: Warm A0 optimizer+C emission on prepared programs under Bun; parsing, process startup, FunctionCache and Clang compilation excluded. Small differences have overlapping raw samples.

regressionCoverage.description: Local updates of boundary/large arrays and records, repeated extras, zero trips, borrowed returns, identical state/extra snapshots, public C calls/caller inputs, IO prefix effects and exhaustion, strict bounds/division, and forced parallel workers.

limitations: Ten changed C kernel modules timed; all29 kernels checked against handwritten C in both optimization modes for baseline and candidate.
Four timed pairs have identical executable .text; their small observed timing differences are retained, not attributed to a code change.

Handwritten C is inline with the standard driver while A0 is separately compiled, following the repository protocol; neither this comparison nor any geometric aggregate establishes universal language leadership.
No startup, energy, total allocation, end-user application or billing-cost measurements.
